svg.title: Featured work — three public systems
svg.desc: Three cards: NosoGraph, a biomedical evidence graph; Agent-Ready, a repository contract for AI agents; and Short Squeeze Screener, a read-only market screener. Each card shows a conceptual diagram and its stack.
